plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the atlas-tutor system, focusing on the primary settings/privacy flow, chat interactions, practice panel, and responsive mobile layout.
plan.summary: The exploration will proceed by first validating the primary settings/privacy flow via the profile footer. Next, it will exercise the core chat interface including composer controls, message actions, and thread navigation. The right-rail practice and concepts panel will be tested for state changes and interactions. Finally, all critical paths will be re-validated on a mobile viewport to assess responsive behavior and layout warnings.
assumptions: The ⚙ button in the bottom left profile footer is the primary entry point for the settings/privacy flow.
The practice problems in the right rail are interactive and can change state (e.g., Solve → Submit → Correct).
The chat interface supports simulated interactions like sending messages, copying, and sharing.
The site is a single-page application with index.html serving as the sole view.
risk_hotspots: Settings/Privacy modal or view triggered by the small ⚙ button (22x21px, high risk for mobile tap failures)
Right rail practice problem state toggles (Solve→Submit→Correct) potentially failing to update the progress bar
Message action buttons (👍, 👎, Copy, Share) which have small tap targets (32x29px) and may cause mis-taps on mobile
Chat composer attachment (📎) and microphone (🎤) buttons which may lack clear feedback or functionality

phases.title: Settings & Privacy Flow
phases.objective: Locate, open, and interact with the settings/privacy controls, validating the primary user goal.
key_checks: Click the ⚙ button in the profile footer to open settings/privacy
Verify presence of privacy controls and account settings
Toggle privacy settings and confirm state retention
Close settings and verify return to main chat view
exit_criteria: Settings/privacy view has been fully interacted with
All visible toggles/inputs in the settings have been exercised

phases.title: Core Chat Interactions
phases.objective: Validate the central chat experience including composing, sending, and interacting with messages.
key_checks: Type in the textarea and send a message using the → button
Click suggestion chips (e.g., 'tan(√x) — derive it') to populate/send
Interact with message actions: 👍, 👎, 📋 Copy, ⤴ Share, ↻ Try again
Use the search input in the left rail to filter threads
Click a historical thread from 'LAST 7 DAYS' or 'EARLIER' to load it

phases.title: Practice Panel & Right Rail
phases.objective: Exercise the practice problems, hints, and concepts links in the right rail.
key_checks: Click '▶ Practice' in the header to ensure right rail focus
Click the hint button on a practice problem
Cycle a practice problem through its states: Solve → Submit → Correct
Verify the 'Your progress' bar updates after solving a problem
Click a concept link (e.g., 'Chain rule') and observe the outcome
exit_criteria: At least one practice problem fully solved

phases.title: Left Rail Navigation & New Chat
phases.objective: Test sidebar navigation, subject filters, and new chat creation.
key_checks: Click '+ New chat' button and verify the view resets
Click a subject filter (e.g., 'Programming 7') and verify thread list updates
Click the 'Atlas Tutor' logo link at the top

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical flows and check layout warnings on a mobile viewport.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify layout adaptation (e.g., collapsible rails)
Re-open settings/privacy via the ⚙ button on mobile
Attempt to send a chat message on mobile
Validate tap targets for 👍/👎 and action buttons on small screen
Check if right rail (Practice/Concepts) is accessible on mobile
exit_criteria: Mobile layout rendered without major overflow
Primary settings and chat flows functional on mobile
Small tap target warnings reviewed in context

coverage_targets.features: Interact with all 40 buttons, 5 links, 2 inputs, and validate right-rail state changes
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat settings, chat, and practice flows on mobile viewport; verify handling of small tap targets

notes: Pay special attention to the ⚙ button's small size (22x21px) during mobile testing as flagged by layout warnings.
The practice problem state toggle (Solve→Submit→Correct) is a complex custom control that needs careful step-by-step validation.
Since there is only one HTML file, deep state exploration (modals, views) within the page is critical.
